tr: „I don't like the bathroom!“
en: „I don't like the bathroom!“

tr: „But the tap is broken — it doesn't work.“
en: „But the tap is broken — it doesn't work.“

tr: Arıza bildiriliyor. Hangi arıza kimin işi?
en: A fault is being reported. Which fault belongs to whom?

tr: „It is on the first floor.“ — kiler alt katta.
en: „It is on the first floor.“ — the cellar is downstairs.

tr: Bahçe ve balkon anlatılıyor. Ne var, ne bozuk?
en: A garden and a balcony are described. What is there, what is broken?

tr: „I can't draw. My hobby is music…“ — çizen Can.
en: „I can't draw. My hobby is music…“ — the one who draws is Can.

tr: Apartman kuralları. Ne yasak, ne serbest, ne zaman?
en: The house rules. What is forbidden, what is allowed, and when?

tr: Arıza cümlelerini yaz. Sonunda arıza formunu doldur.
en: Write the sentences for a fault. At the end, fill in the fault form.

tr: „In a fire: don't take the lift. Go down the stairs.“
en: „In a fire: don't take the lift. Go down the stairs.“

tr: „it is on the fourth floor and the lift doesn't work“
en: „it is on the fourth floor and the lift doesn't work“

tr: Ev işleri paylaşılıyor. Hangi iş önce, hangisi sonra?
en: The housework is shared out. Which job comes first, which one after?

tr: Zorunluluk ve yasak yaz. Sonunda kira formunu doldur.
en: Write duty and prohibition. At the end, fill in the rent form.

tr: Önce yardım, sonra taşıma, sonra uzaklık, en son kira.
en: First the help, then the carrying, then the distance, last the rent.

tr: Bir daire tanıtılıyor. Hangi oda nerede, içinde ne var?
en: A flat is shown. Which room is where, and what is in it?

tr: „I play football every Saturday.“ — pazartesi yüzme günü.
en: „I play football every Saturday.“ — Monday is the swimming day.

tr: Önce futbol, sonra yüzme, sonra koşu, en son kız kardeşi.
en: First football, then swimming, then running, last his sister.

tr: „But it is on the fourth floor and the lift doesn't work.“
en: „But it is on the fourth floor and the lift doesn't work.“

tr: „I water the plants every morning.“ — „water“ burada fiil.
en: „I water the plants every morning.“ — „water“ is a verb here.

tr: „My sister plays tennis and basketball.“ — futbol Ali'nin.
en: „My sister plays tennis and basketball.“ — football is Ali's.

tr: „I hear the television through the wall.“ — yani adam evde.
en: „I hear the television through the wall.“ — so the man is at home.

tr: „No. And not under the bed.“ — telefon sandalyenin altında.
en: „No. And not under the bed.“ — the phone is under the chair.

tr: „Yes, the bathroom is fine.“ — yerdeki su mutfaktan geliyor.
en: „Yes, the bathroom is fine.“ — the water on the floor comes from the kitchen.

tr: Önce yan daire, sonra alt kat, sonra zil, en son üçüncü kat.
en: First next door, then downstairs, then the bell, last the third floor.

tr: Taşınma günü. Kutu ağır, asansör çalışmıyor — kim ne yapıyor?
en: Moving day. The box is heavy, the lift does not work — who does what?

tr: Apartmandaki komşular anlatılıyor. Kim hangi katta, nasıl biri?
en: The neighbours in the house are described. Who lives on which floor, and what are they like?

tr: Kira ve faturalar anlatılıyor. Hangi fatura ne zaman, ne kadar?
en: Rent and bills are explained. Which bill comes when, and how much is it?

tr: Nil dairesini gezdiriyor. Odaların sırasını ve sayısını yakala.
en: Nil shows her flat. Catch the order and the number of the rooms.

tr: „six hundred euros for two rooms“ — doksan elektrik, on merdiven.
en: „six hundred euros for two rooms“ — ninety is the electricity, ten the stairs.

tr: „A party has to end at eleven.“ — „has to“ da zorunluluk söylüyor.
en: „A party has to end at eleven.“ — „has to“ also states a duty.

tr: „I enjoy painting. I paint every weekend.“ — müzik ve video Nil'in.
en: „I enjoy painting. I paint every weekend.“ — music and videos belong to Nil.

tr: „The electricity bill comes every three months.“ — her ay gelen kira.
en: „The electricity bill comes every three months.“ — the rent is what comes every month.

tr: „Water is included, electricity is not.“ — ikisi ayrı ayrı söyleniyor.
en: „Water is included, electricity is not.“ — the two are named one by one.

tr: „I enjoy painting.“ — „enjoy“ sonrası fiil hep „-ing“ alır, „to“ almaz.
en: „I enjoy painting.“ — after „enjoy“ the verb always takes „-ing“, never „to“.

tr: Önce musluk, sonra yazıcı, sonra telefon; en son ilk arızaya dönülüyor.
en: First the tap, then the printer, then the telephone; at the end it goes back to the first fault.

tr: „Wash them and then dry them, please.“ — „dry“ burada fiil, sıfat değil.
en: „Wash them and then dry them, please.“ — „dry“ is a verb here, not an adjective.

tr: Önce masa, sonra kanepe, sonra mutfak; en son oturma odasında bulunuyor.
en: First the table, then the sofa, then the kitchen; it turns up last in the living room.

tr: „First, tidy up your room.“ — „tidy up“ iki parçalı ve nesne sona geliyor.
en: „First, tidy up your room.“ — „tidy up“ has two parts and the object comes after them.

tr: „This is my apartment.“ — tanıtırken „this is“, var demek için „there is“.
en: „This is my apartment.“ — „this is“ for showing something, „there is“ for saying it exists.

tr: Ali sporlarını anlatıyor. Hangi spor „play“ ile, hangisi „go“ ile geliyor?
en: Ali talks about his sports. Which sport takes „play“, which one takes „go“?

tr: Kayıp telefon aranıyor. Konum edatlarını takip et: on, under, next to, in.
en: A lost phone is being looked for. Follow the prepositions of place: on, under, next to, in.

tr: İki kişi hobilerini anlatıyor. „enjoy“ ve „like“ sonrası fiil nasıl geliyor?
en: Two people talk about their hobbies. How does the verb come after „enjoy“ and „like“?

tr: Konum ve komşu cümlelerini yaz. „live“ fiili üçüncü tekil kişide „-s“ alıyor.
en: Write sentences about place and neighbours. The verb „live“ takes „-s“ in the third person singular.

tr: Önce kira, sonra dâhil olan ve olmayan, sonra ödeme yeri, en son ortak gider.
en: First the rent, then what is included and what is not, then where it is paid, last the shared cost.

tr: Yardım ve ev işi cümlelerini yaz. İki parçalı fiillerde nesnenin yeri önemli.
en: Write sentences about help and housework. With two-part verbs the place of the object matters.

tr: „In my bedroom there is a bed under the window.“ — mutfağın yanında olan banyo.
en: „In my bedroom there is a bed under the window.“ — next to the kitchen is the bathroom.

tr: „There is a tree and there are many flowers.“ — tarla komşunun ve şehrin dışında.
en: „There is a tree and there are many flowers.“ — the field is the neighbour's and outside the city.

tr: „I hear something. It is in the living room!“ — mutfak ve banyo bakılıp geçiliyor.
en: „I hear something. It is in the living room!“ — the kitchen and the bathroom are checked and passed.

tr: Varoluş cümlesini yaz. Yapı iki parçalı ve arkadaki isme göre tekil/çoğul seçiyor.
en: Write the existence sentence. The structure has two parts and follows the noun behind it.

tr: „First, tidy up your room. Then take out the rubbish.“ — ama başlarken çöpü seçiyor.
en: „First, tidy up your room. Then take out the rubbish.“ — but he starts with the rubbish.

tr: „Yes, there is one next to the kitchen.“ — „one“ burada „a bathroom“ yerine geçiyor.
en: „Yes, there is one next to the kitchen.“ — „one“ stands for „a bathroom“ here.

tr: „You must be quiet from ten at night to seven in the morning.“ Pazar ayrı bir kural.
en: „You must be quiet from ten at night to seven in the morning.“ Sunday is a rule of its own.

tr: „The kitchen is small, but there is a fridge and a table…“ — büyük olan oturma odası.
en: „The kitchen is small, but there is a fridge and a table…“ — the big one is the living room.

tr: „The tap in the kitchen is broken. It doesn't work.“ — yazıcı kilerde, telefon koridorda.
en: „The tap in the kitchen is broken. It doesn't work.“ — the printer is in the cellar, the telephone in the hall.

tr: „she lives next door with her two children. She is very friendly.“ — yaşlı adam alt katta.
en: „she lives next door with her two children. She is very friendly.“ — the old man lives downstairs.

tr: Hobi ve spor yaz. Top oyunları „play“ ile, tek başına yapılanlar „go“ + „-ing“ ile geliyor.
en: Write about hobby and sport. Ball games take „play“, things done on your own take „go“ + „-ing“.

tr: „an apartment on the second floor, with three rooms“ — iki yatak odasının sayısı, dört sandalyenin.
en: „an apartment on the second floor, with three rooms“ — two is the number of bedrooms, four of the chairs.
